data.name: Benigna
data.gender_notes: Benigna is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'benignus', meaning kind, compassionate, gentle, and merciful. The name Benigna carries the meaning “Kind, compassionate” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Benigna usually hope their child will grow to embody kind, compassionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes benevolence, kindness, and a gentle nature.
data.etymology: Benigna belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Kind, compassionate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Benigna total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: בניגנא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בבניגנא, נעימות הפנים וחביבות נשמתה, כבוד שבעצמה, ובחורה נעימה. נולדה בבית יהודי, והייתה אצל עז נפש במותה. ים של נפש בעל פנים נעימות, מצילת נפשות, וגם נס נורא וגדול.

in_greek.name: Βενιγνά
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Βενιγνά, ἡ ἀγαθή, ἡ εὐπάρεδρος, ἡ ἁγία. Ἀπὸ τῆς Ἐλληνολατινικῆς λέξης Βενιγνά, ἡ Βενιγνά εἶναι ἡ ἡγιασμένη, ἡ σωτήριος, καὶ ἡ ἀγαθή. Ἀπὸ τῆς αἰωνιότητας, ἡ Βενιγνά εἶναι ἡ σωτήριος, ἡ σωτήριος τῆς ψυχῆς.

in_latin.name: Benigna
in_latin.long_meaning: Benigna, bona, benigna, sancta. A bonis, a benignis, a sanctis, Benigna est bona, sancta, et benigna. Ab aeternitate, Benigna est sancta, et animae salus.

in_english.name: Benigna
in_english.long_meaning: Benigna is a kind, gentle, holy, and benevolent name with Hebrew origins, derived from the root בנג (benag), meaning 'to be kind' or 'to do good.' In Christian tradition, Benigna is associated with virtues of compassion, kindness, and generosity. It's a name that reflects a person's inner beauty and their desire to do good to others.

data.cultural_impact: The name Benigna, derived from the Latin word 'benignus', carries a rich cultural significance across various Christian communities. The name represents the legacy of kind-hearted and loving individuals. In various societies, it denotes a gentle and compassionate spirit, often associated with maternal qualities, care, and protection. Benigna is a term that embodies the essence of a nurturing and benevolent soul.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian spirituality, the name Benigna holds deep significance. It reflects the divine nature of God, who is abundantly benevolent and generous towards humanity. The name represents the spiritual qualities Christians aspire to cultivate within themselves - kindness, compassion, mercy, and gentleness. The name Benigna serves as a reminder to extend love and compassion towards others just as God has shown unending compassion towards us. By embracing the name Benigna, one may be inspired to deepen their spiritual connection with God and seek to embody more fully the loving and compassionate aspects of the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Benigna means "kind, gentle, and compassionate" in Latin origins. It symbolizes a strong and nurturing spirit, evoking images of warm hospitality and soothing comfort, much like the benevolent embrace of divine love.

historical_references.reference: Benigna of Trier (d. 353) was the daughter of Emperor Constantine I and was known for her piety and generosity.

modern_usage.modern_context: Benigna is a name of Latin origin, derived from the word benignus, meaning kind, gentle and merciful. It is a name that has been used throughout history and continues to be a popular choice for girls in various parts of the world.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Mary Benigna in Dublin, Ireland credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Benigna, which means "Kind, compassionate". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
